name: python-lambda
description: trailbeam.aws_lambda.wrap (Python) in public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.12, invoked through its Runtime Interface Emulator by the kit's event source mapping (drivers/lambda-poller). Needs Docker and boto3 in the kit's Python.

variants.name: alone
variants.about: the wrapper with its defaults: no body capture, no error text

variants.name: capture
variants.about: body capture and error text on for every queue (contract 15): every receive carries the body, the thrown error's message is on its outcomes
